feature_identity_scope: ADMETlab predictions describe the exact prepared/requested graph or explicitly recorded service-standardized graph; never silently reinterpret a fragment prediction as the original full-complex prediction
official_only_fits: Permitted after complete requested feature snapshot and output audit; use only official experimental labels, with training-only transforms and independent per-cohort selection
frozen_native_expert: Permitted conditionally as a fixed historical predictor with legacy parent/source-aggregation limitations disclosed; strict outer/inner equivalence certificate is not a blanket original-source chemical-purity certificate
legacy_fullfit_companion: May retain the same qualified legacy source policy and strict inner exclusions for consistency with the evaluated expert; not a newly chemically curated full-pool method
fresh_full_pool_supervision: Apply the approved conservative28-request quarantine identically to native control and feature candidate, and preserve four ambiguous cases as flagged rather than confirmed errors
scientific_limit: Lossy representations can predict source-substance assays, but do not establish that those assays measured the retained fragment. Primary official labels and public-source representation provenance remain distinct.
